component.name: Mundus
component.summary: A story-creating studio suite with Write, Characters, Lore and interactiveMap modes

description.p: A story-creating studio suite that integrates a Write mode to tell your stories, a Characters Mode to store and bring your characters to life including a graphic family tree, a Lore mode where you can describe everything about the world, create timelines and map plotlines on a graph and an interactiveMap mode to visualize your creation.
All for as many projects as you like, each with its own data.
Supports export and import from and to various formats and cloud sync between devices after setup.

Android launcher icon regenerated to fill the adaptive-icon safe zone; Linux desktop integration fixed: proper name, icon and full description in GNOME Software via AppStream metadata, and window/dock icon association on Fedora.
